system.description:
Some problems require unusual solutions. These vials are protected from ordinary spillage and breakage, while keeping them easily accessible. When you withdraw a vial, mark off one use and choose one type of vial below:
• Fiery - It can burst into flame.
• Acid - It can melt organic substances.
• Holy - It can cleanse corruption and undeath.
• Distinctive - It can make bright lights and loud noises.
